# Moukey v4.0.1

**A fix release for v4.0.0.** It makes device settings follow the active profile more reliably, stops a keyboard waking up from restarting every connection, and fixes "Open Application" in several action lists.

## ⌨️ Keyboards and profiles

- **Device settings now follow the active profile after a reconnect.** A device that reconnected after launch could start from the settings of the profile that was active at startup, so a key could be remapped, or left dead, in the wrong profile until the next profile switch. New connections now start from the current settings.
- **Mode shift and DPI switch follow the active profile too.** Like the keyboard keys, they were intercepted whenever any profile mapped them, which left them without their native function in profiles where they are set to "Do Nothing". They are now intercepted only while the active profile maps them.
- **A keyboard waking up no longer restarts every connection.** On wake, Moukey tried to restore a gesture control that keyboards do not have, treated the refusal as a failure and reconnected all devices, the mouse included. It now only restores controls the device actually has.
- **The backlight re-enable key is re-armed** after you switch to a profile that maps it and back, when "backlight follows theme" is on and the backlight is off.
- **The extra button of the MX Master 4** is no longer dropped the first time device settings are refreshed, for example on a profile switch.
- **Profile switches are gentler on sleeping devices.** The writes triggered by a switch now wait at most half a second and no longer count towards the "device asleep" state, which could stall every connected device.

## 🧭 Gesture Swipe and Actions Ring

- **"Open Application" works everywhere.** It stored a placeholder that did nothing in the Actions Ring slots, in the Gesture Swipe tap and swipe lists, and in the two horizontal scroll lists. These now open the file picker and keep the chosen program, and an assigned program shows its name.
- **The Gesture Swipe tap and swipe lists no longer offer the Actions Ring.** The ring works by holding its button down, so as a tap or swipe action it only swallowed the gesture.
- **A warning when the Actions Ring replaces Gesture Swipe.** Both need the button held down, so giving a button the ring turns off its saved swipe and tap actions. They are kept, and Moukey now tells you they are inactive.
- Actions Ring slots that hold a shortcut or an application show it on the right row of the list instead of "Do Nothing".

## 📝 Notes

- Tested on Windows with automated tests; the reconnect and wake fixes have not yet been confirmed on a physical keyboard.
- The Actions Ring is designed for the MX Master 4 and is still offered on other mice.
